{
  "candidate_rtl": "module comparator_16bit (
    input [15:0] A,
    input [15:0] B,
    output gt,
    output eq,
    output lt
);
    wire [15:0] same;
    wire [15:0] greater_bit;
    wire [3:0] group_equal;
    wire [3:0] group_greater;

    assign same = ~(A ^ B);
    assign greater_bit = A & ~B;

    genvar k;
    generate
        for (k = 0; k < 4; k = k + 1) begin : compare_groups
            assign group_equal[k] = &same[4*k +: 4];
            assign group_greater[k] =
                greater_bit[4*k+3] |
                (same[4*k+3] & greater_bit[4*k+2]) |
                (same[4*k+3] & same[4*k+2] & greater_bit[4*k+1]) |
                (same[4*k+3] & same[4*k+2] & same[4*k+1] & greater_bit[4*k]);
        end
    endgenerate

    assign eq = &group_equal;
    assign gt = group_greater[3] |
                (group_equal[3] & group_greater[2]) |
                (group_equal[3] & group_equal[2] & group_greater[1]) |
                (group_equal[3] & group_equal[2] & group_equal[1] & group_greater[0]);
    assign lt = ~(gt | eq);
endmodule",
  "bottleneck": "The original mapped maximum arrival is 0.88 ns at gt. Its shared comparison network also puts eq on a relatively deep path, with a 0.31 ns NOR stage near the outputs.",
  "rewrite": "Use four parallel four-bit lexicographic comparisons, followed by a four-way lookahead combination. Compute equality directly from shared bitwise XNOR terms. Implement only one directional comparison and derive lt from the mutually exclusive gt and eq results.",
  "expected_timing_gain": "The bounded-width lookahead structure targets a shorter comparison path than the original mapped network. No mapped timing measurement is available for this candidate; improvement over 0.88 ns must be verified, especially for the final NOR on lt.",
  "area_or_other_cost": "Sharing equality terms and omitting a separate less-than comparison limits duplication and leaves room for buffering. The 547.775360 um2 area cap and zero slew/capacitance violations require mapped validation; neither is claimed as measured.",
  "functional_boundaries": "Preserves the original module name and unsigned 16-bit input and scalar output ports. There are no parameters, storage elements, dependencies, or undefined outputs. For every binary input pair, gt identifies the highest differing bit with A equal to one, eq identifies complete equality, and lt is exactly the remaining unsigned ordering case."
}
